name: Kugatachi Nadeshiko
source:
Division: MWPSB CID Division 1
Occupation: Inspector
Date of Birth: 10-30-2087

A new Inspector who was assigned to the Public Safe Bureau's CID Division 1. Having lost all her memories, she is very serious and always takes [url=/c66254]Kagari's[/url] jokes too literally. She is never satisfied until she can make a logical sense of everything, and she keeps her composure no matter what.

[From Digital Art Book]
